name: Extra Dim Control
description: Turns Android's Extra dim (reduce_bright_colors_activated) on and off through Kiosk Satellite's Shizuku connection, by hand or automatically from room light or panel brightness. Exposes a Home Assistant switch and On, Off and Toggle actions for gestures and the drawer. Built for Samsung tablets and works on any Android 12+ device with the same setting.
author: Jonathan Robichaud

settings.title: Set intensity
settings.description: Also write reduce_bright_colors_level whenever Extra dim is turned on. Leave off to keep the intensity chosen on the tablet.

settings.title: Intensity
settings.description: 0 is the mildest dimming and 100 the strongest.

settings.title: Check state every
settings.description: How often to read the setting so Home Assistant notices changes made from quick settings.

settings.title: Automatic
settings.description: Room light follows the light sensor. Panel brightness follows the screen level that adaptive brightness sets. Manual changes stay until the light crosses the other threshold.

settings.title: Turn off at or above
settings.description: Keep this higher than the on level so Extra dim does not flicker.

settings.title: Wait before switching
settings.description: The light has to stay past a threshold this long, so a passing shadow does not trigger it.
